question: What is the origin of Otto's name?
answer: "Oops, oops, that won't do." (note: the oops here is pronounced similar to Otto's name) I know it may be shocking, but there's no particular origin. At the time when I wrote "I need to get back to the domain in a big hurry. I need a travelling merchant, weakened by alcohol, who I can pay, who will make the trip and won't ask the details!", it was Otto.
